text:
elin: quick follow-up: i want to avoid double writes for realtime billing. propose a claim+commit pattern on a single append-only stream. deltas written immediately, commit reconciles final units. thoughts?
samir: sounds promising. how do you dedupe retries?
elin: deltas carry deterministic origin_fingerprint. commit references that token. commit is idempotent by token.
jessica: UI impact? will customers see provisional numbers?
elin: yes — show provisional badge until commit. default commit window 12h. enterprise can configure.
kai: operational note: shard by tenant to avoid global CAS. use per-tenant partitioned log.
elin: agreed. then commit_position = log offset, no DB-wide CAS.
samir: late-arrival/chunking: commits must include compensation list for previous tokens.
jessica: invoices should only read committed totals. add strong contract.
metering-bot: infra: provisioning topic billing-commit-v2 Tue 02:00 UTC. ticket https://git.redwood/infraproj/1456
elin: migration: compatibility shim converts legacy billing_event -> delta for 30d, run reconciler in dry-run, then flip.
kai: add alerts: commit_lag, compensation_rate, reconciliation_fail_pct.
samir: +1. can we simulate noisy tenants in dry-run?
elin: yes will add canary mesh (small/med/large tenants). drafting RFC follow-up with schemas & runbook.
metering-bot: reminder: add unit tests for token claim idempotency.
